ops.entry: WHEN a real finding's only remedy edits a file in no task's declared set, or amends signed intent or criterion wording, DO route it up — ESCALATE if it gates, an open question if not — never must_fix: no fix cycle may legally apply it.
ops.why: Two cycle-1 reader findings were real but their remedies rewrote a signed task intent and a signed criterion's marker; routing them as open questions instead of must_fix kept the fix round on the test-only defects. Generalizes G-06's file-set case to signed-wording remedies.

ops.entry: WHEN a must-fix restructures tests to clear a structural gate DO put 'every predicate still rejects what it rejected before' in its acceptance — gate exit 0 and an unchanged PASS-name set both held while a string check collapsed to truthiness, caught only a cycle later.
ops.why: The complexity-driven split cleared code-grade with identical PASS-name sets yet weakened a reason check to bool(); only the next panel's code-reviewer probe found it. Displaces O-02, a malformed (double-prefixed) entry whose content is an implementation rule other personas already hold, not a lead outcome.

originals.original: WHEN a gate is genuinely false but every remedy edits a file inside no task's declared file set DO return ESCALATE rather than FAIL — FAIL routes a fix cycle at a file nobody may edit, and the cycle is spent proving that.

O-02: WHEN a stricter lock exposes a real production site DO derive that site from the governing authority rather than exempt it — exemptions preserve the parallel source of truth the lock exists to remove.
